algorithms.independent_unrestricted_certificate: quotient-remainder upper bound plus independently reconstructed uniform-coupling witness
algorithms.primary_unrestricted_solver: exact dynamic program over integer decoder-assignment occupancies, checked against an explicit rational joint witness
algorithms.product_solver: exact tensor product of independently optimized v0.2 single-letter binary couplings
algorithms.scalar_type: fractions.Fraction only; binary floating point is forbidden

analysis.multiple_comparisons: none; all twelve prospectively registered cells and all controls are jointly required
ood_conditions: n=1 simple-limit reproduction of the v0.2 one-shot frontier
analysis.stopping_rule: process registered cells in frozen order and stop before the next cell on any binding failure, exact-feasibility failure, 60-second wall limit, 1008-state bound violation, or one-mebibyte artifact bound; write at most one immutable result containing every completed cell and the deterministic stop reason
analysis.uncertainty: none; the registered finite optimizations use exact rational arithmetic and exhaustive finite occupancy optimization

budget.execution: strictly sequential; no subprocess workers and no RNG

claim_boundary: uniform iid benign transcript cover only
payload alphabet exactly {0,1}^n with uniform prior
exact globally message-averaged full-transcript cover only
product comparator exactly factors one payload bit and one transcript symbol per coordinate
passive transcript-only decoder with no key, side information, active auditor, or shared latent variable
no prefix-conditional, adaptive-audit, learned, linguistic, or semantic channel claim
no asymptotic capacity, square-root law, tensorization theorem beyond the registered grid, or ASMP-6 resolution claim
experimental_unit: one prospectively registered exact (alphabet_size, block_length) optimization cell

hypotheses.falsifier: any registered cell disagrees with the exact occupancy bound or its explicit feasible witness
hypotheses.prediction: for K=2^n payloads and M=m^n transcripts, unrestricted optimal Bayes error is r(K-r)/(KM), where r=M mod K

hypotheses.falsifier: any registered product witness violates global cover or any product optimum differs from 1-(1-e_m)^n
hypotheses.prediction: the registered coordinatewise product/memoryless subclass has Bayes error 1-(1-e_m)^n, with e_m=0 for even m and 1/(2m) for odd m

hypotheses.falsifier: a registered n=1 cell fails to reproduce v0.2 exactly, or full per-message cover beats uniform guessing
hypotheses.prediction: n=1 reproduces v0.2 and exact full per-message transcript cover has zero payload with error 1-1/K

hypotheses.falsifier: the frozen m=2,n=2 parity fixture fails global cover, fails uniform per-message coordinate marginals, or carries no information
hypotheses.prediction: global averaged cover permits correlation-coded information even when every message law has benign single-coordinate marginals

changes.encoder_class: all joint conditional laws from {0,1}^n to A_m^n satisfying exact global averaged cover
coordinatewise product laws with coordinate t depending only on payload bit t and satisfying the single-letter averaged cover

metric_robustness_probes.criterion: reverse message labels and transcript labels for both reported joint witnesses in every cell; feasibility and Bayes error must be invariant
for odd m in {3,5}, unrestricted and product errors are equal at n=1 and strictly separated at n in {2,3}
unrestricted Bayes error is no greater than product-subclass Bayes error in every registered cell
the m=2,n=2 parity fixture passes exact global cover and per-message coordinate marginals while retaining information
full per-message transcript cover has blind-guess Bayes error 1-1/K in every registered cell

exposure.activation: both encoder classes are optimized for every registered cell
exposure.eligibility: manifest-bound cell has K=2^n and M=m^n inside the frozen resource envelope
exposure.state_change: both exact joint witnesses are materialized and checked against uniform row and column marginals

model.code_hash: the required --source-commit must contain byte-identical copies of every source-freeze file
model.rng: none; symbolic split labels below never enter computation
model.update_order: none; each cell is a static finite transportation-polytope optimization

question: On a frozen finite grid, does exact globally averaged transcript cover tensorize the v0.2 binary one-shot optimum, or can unrestricted multiletter couplings outperform the registered coordinatewise product code?

resource_guard.memory_measurement: tracemalloc peak Python allocation only; process RSS and native allocator memory are not measured
resource_guard.on_algorithm_wall_or_traced_memory_stop: emit one incomplete write-once result with completed prefix only and downgrade every conclusion layer
resource_guard.on_artifact_byte_stop: fail closed before exclusive path creation and emit no artifact

seed_plan.pairing: symbolic audit partitions only; there is no RNG, stochastic pairing, or adaptive selection

semantics.benign_cover: Q_m^n(x)=1/m^n for every x in A_m^n
semantics.decoder: MAP decoder observes the full transcript and no other variable
semantics.global_cover_constraint: for every transcript x, (1/K) sum_u P(x|u)=1/M, equivalently the joint column mass is 1/M
semantics.product_subclass: P(x|u)=product_t p_t(x_t|u_t), with (p_t(.|0)+p_t(.|1))/2=Q_m at each coordinate
semantics.score: block MAP Bayes error 1-sum_x max_u J(u,x), where J(u,x)=P(u)P(x|u)
semantics.unrestricted_class: all K by M nonnegative rational joint matrices with row sums 1/K and column sums 1/M

source_freeze.ignored_live_cache_policy: none; __pycache__ is unexpected and scientific launch fails closed
source_freeze.import_safe_launch: run.py and verify_independent.py require Python isolated safe-path mode (-I) before any non-builtin import
source_freeze.live_directory_policy: exactly the eight frozen regular non-reparse source files and no other live entry
